svg.title: sinjeong_arcade schematic
svg.text: sinjeong_arcade · the Sinjeong underground arcade surge (ch33–40)
Schematic plan in metres, north up. A fictional shopping arcade under the Sinjeong station plaza (Line 5), Sinjeong-dong, Yangcheon-gu. Seven gates open in its food court and
corridors (ch34). No key or script yet: the layout is decided here so that Passage F, the pharmacy, the wall and the storeroom route work as the beats need.
STREET LEVEL ABOVE: station plaza and the main road (dashed outlines = at street level)
• ch33 hook: the alert, "300+ trapped". GMA dispatch calls
• ch34: the GMA command tent on the plaza; the bidding on
speakerphones. Seoryun takes the deepest entry (S1, food
court). Ryu Survey + Taeo's crew get SIDE PASSAGE F. Taeo
holds the EXIT F stairwell with the radio; a child's shoe on
• ch35: the pharmacy full of civilians; the knock works
through its service door onto F. Baek walks past outside. S5
expands: a WALL now stands across F where the corridor was.
• ch36: Nib reads the smoke flow: F → the shop's storeroom →
the concourse → back into F west of the wall → EXIT F (red
route). At street level S7 breaks out at Taeo's stairwell;
he props the door; the hound; Seoryun's shield.
diamond) in the surge zone by the cross passage:
Seoryun: "LEAVE IT." Orrin holds a collapsing
ceiling in F east of the wall while the last
civilians crawl past; his shell cracks.
• ch38: Nib carries the last child out; three
knocks; Seoryun walks the last person out of her
• ch39–40: dawn on the kerb outside EXIT F: the
crews' line, "NIB, WAS IT? GOOD WORK.", the
• ch45: arcade glass, one of three fragments
recovered on the approach, is window 4's third

• EXIT F is the street-side service
stairwell at the WEST end of Passage F;
Taeo never goes below its landing.
• Gate ids S1–S7 are local to this chapter
